Instructions:
1. Connect this phone to Wi-Fi and complete sign-in if prompted.
2. Turn on this phone's Mobile Hotspot and connect your other device to it.
3. Tap 'Start Wi-Fi Bridge'.
4. On your other device, set its SOCKS5 proxy to this phone's hotspot IP address (shown above) on port 1080.
5. The bridge automatically stops if this phone's Wi-Fi disconnects or becomes invalid.
